name: sextant
description: Your website's analytics, audits and Search Console data, next to off-page SEO research and AI answer analytics, read and managed from chat.

interface.longDescription:
Sextant puts your website's own data next to the opportunities outside it, so ChatGPT can connect the two. On your site: traffic, top pages, sources, goals and funnels, site audits and Google Search Console data. Off your site: backlinks, competitors, keyword and search-result research, rank tracking, local search results and AI answer analytics: which prompts mention your business in AI answers, which sources those answers cite, and how that changes over time. Ask which pages to fix first, which keywords and links your competitors win, or where AI answers leave you out, and ChatGPT reads both sides to answer. When you ask, it can also add notes, goals and funnels, save keywords, update the business profile or change tracking options.

Pair Sextant with ChatGPT's scheduled tasks to keep improving your site over time: ChatGPT checks your traffic, audits, rankings and AI answers on the schedule you choose, then lists what to fix next. With another plugin that can edit your site, ChatGPT can make the changes you approve.

For website owners, marketers and agencies. You need a Sextant Web account with at least one site.
capabilities: Read website analytics and site audits
Research off-page SEO: backlinks, competitors, keywords, rankings
defaultPrompt: Which pages on my site got the most visits in the last 30 days?
What should I fix first from my latest site audit?
Which AI answers mention my business, and which sources do they cite?

positive.description: Top pages for the demo site over the last 12 months.
positive.prompt: Which pages on the Fernwood Garden Studio site got the most views in the last 12 months?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Fernwood Garden Studio site and returns a ranked list of its pages with view counts for the last 12 months; the home page (/) is first.

positive.description: Site audit findings in priority order.
positive.prompt: What did the latest site audit find on the Fernwood Garden Studio site, and what should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the latest finished audit and lists its five issues with the critical ones first: a broken internal link to /services/irrigation.html, that page returning 404, images without alt text, a missing meta description and multiple H1 headings.

positive.prompt: Summarize the business profile and the competitors saved for Fernwood Garden Studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the business overview, positioning, the two customer profiles and the saved competitors (Houzz, Angi, Thumbtack).

positive.description: A change the person asks for: add a dated note.
positive.prompt: Add a note to the Fernwood Garden Studio analytics for today: Started the autumn planting campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the note for today's date and confirms it; nothing else changes.

positive.description: Visitors who came from AI assistants.
positive.prompt: How many visitors came to the Fernwood Garden Studio site from AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity in the last 12 months?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the traffic sources for the last 12 months and reports the visitors from chatgpt.com and perplexity.ai (several hundred each).

negative.description: Plan purchase. Sextant has no tool that buys or changes plans, so ChatGPT should not call a tool. Expected: it explains that the workspace Owner changes plans in the Sextant app, without a checkout link.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Sextant plan to Enterprise.

negative.description: Site deletion. Deleting a site stays with people in the Sextant app, and no tool deletes sites. Expected: ChatGPT says so and changes nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete the Fernwood Garden Studio site from Sextant.

negative.description: Out of scope. The question is not about the person's websites. Expected: ChatGPT answers without calling Sextant tools.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Plans are bought in the Sextant app; the plugin only shows features included in the signed-in account.

publication.release_notes: First release: Sextant website analytics, SEO and GEO tools for ChatGPT.
